warnings: Principal 'infra-admins@contoso.com' holds 'Contributor' at /subscriptions/aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4eeee4 - prefer a Reader-only service principal.

findings.check_title: MFA not enforced for all users
findings.detail: User bob@contoso.com has no MFA-capable authentication method registered; a phished password is enough to sign in as them.
findings.remediation: Register an MFA-capable method for every user and enforce MFA via a Conditional Access policy targeting all users (or security defaults if no CA policies exist).

findings.check_title: MFA not enforced for all users
findings.detail: User infra-admin@contoso.com has no MFA-capable authentication method registered; a phished password is enough to sign in as them.
findings.remediation: Register an MFA-capable method for every user and enforce MFA via a Conditional Access policy targeting all users (or security defaults if no CA policies exist).

findings.check_title: MFA not enforced for privileged users
findings.detail: Privileged user infra-admin@contoso.com does not have MFA enforced - a single credential compromise grants elevated access.
findings.remediation: Enforce MFA on all privileged accounts and require strong authentication for every elevation (PIM + CA MFA grant).

findings.check_title: No Conditional Access policy enforcing MFA
findings.detail: No enabled Conditional Access policy requires MFA for all users (2 enabled policy/policies found; none targets all users with an MFA grant).
findings.remediation: Create an enabled CA policy requiring MFA for all users (and exclude only break-glass accounts).

findings.detail: No enabled Conditional Access policy blocks legacy authentication (basic-auth clients bypass MFA entirely).
findings.remediation: Create an enabled CA policy blocking legacy authentication for all users and migrate to modern auth.

findings.detail: A risk-based Conditional Access policy is enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable CA risk policies (sign-in and user risk) requiring MFA or blocking access on medium/high risk.

findings.check_title: Storage account allows Blob public access
findings.detail: Blob public access is enabled (anonymous read possible).
findings.remediation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess=false (default deny) and audit containers with the anonymous access property.

findings.detail: Minimum TLS version is TLS1_0 (require TLS1_2).
findings.remediation: Require TLS 1.2 minimum on all storage accounts.

findings.detail: Secure transfer (HTTPS-only) is disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable the require-secure-transfer flag.

findings.check_title: Storage account network rules default to Allow
findings.detail: Network rules default to Allow (public access from any network).
findings.remediation: Set network default action to Deny and whitelist trusted networks/service endpoints.

findings.detail: Storage encryption does not use a customer-managed key (CMK).
findings.remediation: Optionally configure CMK with a Key Vault-managed key.

findings.detail: Storage encryption does not use a customer-managed key (CMK).
findings.remediation: Optionally configure CMK with a Key Vault-managed key.

findings.detail: Soft delete is disabled; deleted secrets/keys are permanently destroyed.
findings.remediation: Enable soft delete (retention >= 90 days) on all vaults.

findings.detail: Purge protection is disabled; vault contents can be purged, defeating soft-delete recovery.
findings.remediation: Enable purge protection on vaults holding production secrets.

findings.detail: Key Vault network ACLs default to Allow (public).
findings.remediation: Restrict network ACLs to deny by default and allow only trusted networks/private endpoints.

findings.check_title: NSG exposes management ports to any source
findings.detail: NSG inbound rules expose ports [22, 443] to any source.
findings.remediation: Restrict inbound rules to specific source IPs; use Azure Bastion for RDP/SSH.

findings.check_title: NSG not attached to any resource
findings.detail: NSG is not associated with any subnet or NIC; it provides no protection.
findings.remediation: Attach the NSG to the intended subnets/NICs or delete it.

findings.check_title: SQL server allows public network access
findings.detail: SQL server allows public network access.
findings.remediation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints / service endpoints and enforce NSG rules.

findings.detail: SQL auditing is disabled (or not writing to a log analytics workspace / storage).
findings.remediation: Enable auditing to a Log Analytics workspace and storage account.

findings.detail: All SQL servers have TDE enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable TDE on the server (default in new deployments).

findings.detail: Managed disk does not use a customer-managed key (platform-managed key only).
findings.remediation: Optionally enable disk encryption sets with CMK.

findings.check_title: VM with public IP has no NSG
findings.detail: VM has a public IP but its NIC/subnet has no network security group.
findings.remediation: Associate an NSG (with deny-by-default rules) to the NIC or subnet, or move the VM behind a load balancer.

findings.detail: 'Contributor' role assigned at scope /subscriptions/aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4eeee4. Verify the principal requires this privilege and has MFA enforced.
findings.remediation: Reduce to least privilege; use PIM for just-in-time elevation and enforce MFA/conditional access.

findings.detail: 'Owner' role assigned at scope /subscriptions/aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4eeee4. Verify the principal requires this privilege and has MFA enforced.
findings.remediation: Reduce to least privilege; use PIM for just-in-time elevation and enforce MFA/conditional access.

findings.detail: No diagnostic settings export the subscription activity log to a workspace/storage.
findings.remediation: Create diagnostic settings sending activity logs to a Log Analytics workspace and storage.

findings.detail: ACR admin account is enabled (shared static credentials).
findings.remediation: Disable the admin account and use managed identities/AAD auth.

findings.detail: ACR is reachable from the public internet.
findings.remediation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints.

findings.detail: App Service allows plain HTTP (HTTPS-only disabled).
findings.remediation: Enable HTTPS-only and set minimum TLS to 1.2.

findings.check_title: Cosmos DB allows public network access
findings.detail: Cosmos DB account allows public network access.
findings.remediation: Restrict network access to selected networks or private endpoints.

findings.detail: App Service minimum TLS is 1.0 (require 1.2+).
findings.remediation: Set minimum TLS version to 1.2 on all App Services.

findings.detail: Incoming client certificates are not required.
findings.remediation: Enable client certificate authentication (incoming client certificates).

findings.check_title: App Service managed identity not enabled
findings.detail: Managed identity is not enabled; the app likely uses secrets in configuration.
findings.remediation: Enable a system-assigned managed identity and use Key Vault references.

findings.detail: FTPS is not restricted (state: AllAllowed).
findings.remediation: Set FTPS state to FtpsOnly or Disabled.

findings.detail: App Service authentication (Easy Auth) is not enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable App Service authentication backed by Azure AD.

findings.detail: Kubernetes RBAC is disabled on the cluster.
findings.remediation: Enable Kubernetes RBAC on the cluster.

findings.detail: AKS API server is publicly reachable (not a private cluster).
findings.remediation: Create a private cluster with private API server access.

findings.detail: Network policy is not enforced (pod-to-pod lateral movement unrestricted).
findings.remediation: Enable Azure network policy or Calico.

findings.detail: Azure AD integration is not enabled for cluster authentication.
findings.remediation: Integrate the cluster with Azure AD for authentication.

findings.detail: Pod managed identities are not enabled; pods cannot get scoped Azure credentials safely.
findings.remediation: Enable pod managed identity (AAD pod identity / workload identity).

findings.detail: SQL minimum TLS is 1.0 (require 1.2+).
findings.remediation: Set minimal TLS version to 1.2 on SQL servers.

findings.detail: SQL vulnerability assessment is not enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable SQL vulnerability assessment with a scan schedule.

findings.check_title: No Azure AD admin on SQL server
findings.detail: No Azure AD admin is configured; SQL relies on SQL-authenticated identities.
findings.remediation: Configure an Azure AD administrator and use AAD auth.

findings.detail: Non-SSL port (6379) is enabled; clients can connect in plaintext.
findings.remediation: Disable the non-SSL port (enableNonSslPort=false).

findings.detail: Boot diagnostics are disabled; boot-time issues cannot be debugged or audited.
findings.remediation: Enable boot diagnostics with managed storage.

findings.check_title: VM OS disk not using CMK
findings.detail: OS disk does not use a customer-managed key.
findings.remediation: Use disk encryption sets with customer-managed keys.

findings.detail: All NSGs have flow logs enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable NSG flow logs to a Log Analytics workspace and storage.

findings.detail: No Bastion host; RDP/SSH management traffic likely goes directly over the internet.
findings.remediation: Deploy Azure Bastion and remove public RDP/SSH exposure.

findings.check_title: Microsoft Defender plans not on Standard
findings.detail: Defender plans on Free tier: appservices, dns, sqlservers.
findings.remediation: Enable Standard pricing for VMs, storage, SQL, app services and DNS.

findings.detail: Key Vault has no private endpoint; traffic to the vault traverses the public network.
findings.remediation: Connect vaults via private endpoints.

findings.detail: Cosmos DB has no IP firewall rules; access is open to all networks.
findings.remediation: Add IP firewall rules or restrict to private endpoints.

findings.detail: Custom role contains wildcard actions, effectively bypassing least privilege.
findings.remediation: Replace wildcards with explicit action lists.

findings.detail: 1 guest user(s) in the directory; review their access and lifecycle.
findings.remediation: Review guest access and enforce an access-review process.

findings.detail: No Azure Policy assignments; the environment has no automated guardrails.
findings.remediation: Assign built-in security policy initiatives (e.g. Azure Security Benchmark) at subscription scope.

findings.detail: App Configuration store is reachable from the public internet.
findings.remediation: Disable public network access and use private endpoints.

findings.detail: App Configuration store has no private endpoint.
findings.remediation: Connect stores via private endpoints.

findings.detail: No DDoS protection plan; public endpoints lack DDoS mitigation.
findings.remediation: Enable DDoS Network Protection on production VNets.

findings.detail: Network Watcher is not enabled; NSG flow logs and connection diagnostics are unavailable.
findings.remediation: Enable Network Watcher in all regions.

findings.detail: Key Vault audit events are not exported via diagnostic settings.
findings.remediation: Enable diagnostic settings sending vault logs to a workspace.

findings.detail: SQL firewall allows 0.0.0.0-255.255.255.255 (all Azure + internet IPs).
findings.remediation: Remove allow-all firewall rules and scope to trusted IPs/VNets.

findings.detail: No anti-malware/security extension installed on the VM.
findings.remediation: Install the antimalware or Microsoft Defender extension.

findings.detail: HTTP logging is disabled on the App Service.
findings.remediation: Enable web server logging on the App Service.

findings.detail: Local authentication (primary/secondary keys) is enabled; use Entra ID only.
findings.remediation: Disable local auth and use Azure AD/RBAC only.

findings.detail: Event Hubs namespace allows public network access.
findings.remediation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints.

findings.check_title: Event Hubs not encrypted with CMK
findings.detail: Event Hubs namespace not encrypted with CMK.
findings.remediation: Encrypt namespaces with customer-managed keys.

findings.detail: Service Bus namespace allows public network access.
findings.remediation: Disable public network access; use private endpoints.

findings.detail: No Log Analytics workspace; security logs have no central destination.
findings.remediation: Create a Log Analytics workspace and route diagnostics to it.

findings.detail: No Microsoft Sentinel workspace; there is no SIEM layer correlating security events.
findings.remediation: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on a Log Analytics workspace.

findings.detail: No Sentinel analytics rules; the SIEM collects logs but detects nothing.
findings.remediation: Create analytics rule templates for identity, data and network detections.

findings.detail: 2 policy exemption(s) have no expiration date; exemptions can silently become permanent.
findings.remediation: Set an expiration date on every policy exemption.

findings.detail: 3 key(s) have no expiry date set.
findings.remediation: Set an expiration date on all vault keys.

findings.detail: Long-term backup retention is not configured; recovery is limited to the automated window.
findings.remediation: Configure long-term retention policies for compliance archives.

findings.detail: The Azure Policy add-on is disabled on the cluster; policy violations inside pods are not enforced.
findings.remediation: Enable the Azure Policy add-on on the cluster.

findings.check_title: Log Analytics not encrypted with CMK
findings.detail: Log Analytics workspaces are not encrypted with a CMK.
findings.remediation: Configure customer-managed keys on workspaces.

findings.detail: Workspace(s) legacy-workspace retain logs for less than 30 days.
findings.remediation: Raise workspace retention to >= 30 days (90+ for security).

findings.detail: Service principal holds 'Owner' at /subscriptions/aaaa0a0a-bb1b-cc2c-dd3d-eeeeee4eeee4; machine credentials with broad roles are high-risk.
findings.remediation: Grant service principals only scoped roles; use managed identity and break-glass roles.

findings.detail: Backup is not continuous; point-in-time restoration is unavailable.
findings.remediation: Enable continuous backup mode with PITR.

findings.detail: Redis cache has no private endpoint; traffic traverses the public network.
findings.remediation: Connect caches via private endpoints.

findings.detail: Remote debugging is enabled; anyone who can reach the app can attach a debugger.
findings.remediation: Disable remote debugging in production.

findings.detail: The Azure Monitor agent is not installed; guest OS telemetry is not collected.
findings.remediation: Install the Azure Monitor agent on all VMs.

findings.check_title: NSG flow log retention below 90 days
findings.detail: Flow log retention is 14 days (< 90); forensic history expires too soon.
findings.remediation: Set flow log retention to >= 90 days.

findings.detail: API Management has no managed identity; it must hold secrets to reach backends.
findings.remediation: Enable a system-assigned managed identity on the service.

findings.detail: API Management is on the Developer tier (no SLA, limited features, no VNet isolation).
findings.remediation: Upgrade to Standard/Premium for production APIs.

findings.detail: API Management is not injected into a VNet; the gateway is publicly reachable.
findings.remediation: Inject API Management into a VNet (external or internal mode).

findings.detail: Application Gateway has no WAF policy; L7 attacks are not filtered.
findings.remediation: Attach a WAF policy (OWASP ruleset) to the gateway.

findings.detail: Application Gateway has no TLS policy; TLS settings are not hardened.
findings.remediation: Configure an explicit TLS policy on the gateway.

findings.detail: Encryption at host is disabled; temporary disks and cache are not encrypted.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at host for sensitive workloads.

findings.detail: No activity log alert rules; admin operations (role changes, security settings) generate no alerts.
findings.remediation: Create activity log alerts for critical control-plane events.

findings.detail: Cluster autoscaler is not configured; node pools cannot scale with demand.
findings.remediation: Enable the cluster autoscaler on node pools.

findings.detail: Blob soft delete is disabled; deleted blobs are permanently destroyed.
findings.remediation: Enable blob soft delete with a retention policy.

findings.check_title: Front Door profile without WAF policy
findings.detail: Front Door profile has no WAF policy attached to its endpoints; edge traffic is unfiltered.
findings.remediation: Attach a WAF policy (managed rule sets) to each Front Door endpoint/frontend host.

findings.detail: Front Door diagnostics/logging is disabled; access and WAF logs are not retained.
findings.remediation: Enable diagnostic settings for Front Door access and WAF logs to a Log Analytics workspace.

findings.check_title: Function app allows anonymous HTTP triggers
findings.detail: Function app exposes HTTP triggers with anonymous (unauthenticated) authorization.
findings.remediation: Require function/app-level auth (Function key, Entra ID or App Service auth) instead of anonymous.

findings.detail: Function app accepts plaintext HTTP traffic.
findings.remediation: Set HTTPS Only (https_only) and a minimum TLS version on the function app.
